name: Meteoric-Playa
description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by a nearby asteroid belt near the terminator.

Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit. Something scrubbed this biosphere clean within a geological instant. The rocks remember it as a thin black line.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
